language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon is acquired and lifted from the table in frames 48–60 (ceiling, wrist_left, wrist_right), then transferred between grippers in frames 94–104 (wrist_left, wrist_right). The robot carries it over the blue box and releases it in frames 127–129 (ceiling, wrist_right). Frames 130–151 (ceiling) show the spoon remaining inside the box as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unintended collision, or other side effect is visibly established.
